definitions.gloss: to release, to let go, to set free
definitions.explanation: To allow something or someone to go free; to release from confinement.

definitions.gloss: to fire, to shoot, to launch
definitions.explanation: To discharge a projectile such as an arrow, bullet, or light.
To produce and send out light, smell, or other emanations.

examples.japanese: {的|まと}を{狙|ねら}って{矢|や}を{放|はな}った。
examples.english: I aimed at the target and shot an arrow.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}を{空|そら}に{放|はな}つ。
examples.english: To release a bird into the sky.

examples.japanese: {強|つよ}い{香|かお}りを{放|はな}っている。
examples.english: It's giving off a strong fragrance.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{放|はな}つ.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{矢|や}を{放|はな}つ (to shoot an arrow)
・{光|ひかり}を{放|はな}つ (to emit light)
・{香|かお}りを{放|はな}つ (to give off a fragrance)
・{野|の}に{放|はな}つ (to release into the wild)

RELATED:
・{放|はな}す - to release, to let go (similar meaning but different nuance)
・{解|かい}{放|ほう} - liberation, release
